inputs.prompt: ONE continuous unbroken real-time shot, constant motion, no freezing, the action never stops: the camera holds on the red desert caravan beneath the giant ringed planet, then fireballs start raining from the sky, meteor trails streaking past the lens. The camels panic and scatter, dust exploding around their hooves, as the first meteors slam into the dunes. The camera sweeps up toward the hovering mothership just as a meteor tears through its hull, the ship tilts and erupts in a bloom of fire, debris raining down. Ending close on burning wreckage falling toward the desert as the ground shakes. Audio in layers: a low rumble building into deafening meteor strikes and explosions, camel cries and thundering hooves, the mothership's engines screaming into a final blast. Photorealistic, cinematic, smoke and embers drifting past the lens. No on-screen text, no subtitles.
